observations: body L1-L2, L8, L13, L15-L16, L20-L23: the dashes of the transliterated names and titles and of «1288–1370» and «157–58» are long dashes (5.2 to 5.5 pt).
body L1, L5, L9: the dashes after «4° 27′.», before «Ex astronomis» and after «IV.» measure 9.7 to 10.3 pt and are transcribed as dashes.
body L3-L5: 3600″ : 43 2/3 = 82″,44 = 1′ 22″ 26‴ 33ⁱᵛ,6 a year; the printed 1′ 19″ 39‴ 53ⁱᵛ,6 is 1° in 45,19 years, and less the precession of 54″ 33‴ it leaves 25″ 6‴ 53ⁱᵛ,6 (printed 25″ 3‴).
body L10-L24: the longitudes stand in a column at the right of the list.
notes_left L1: Nallino's addenda et emendanda (Part I, p. LXXIV) read «218, adn. 1, pro Riccii l. Ricii.»; the printed form is kept.
notes_left L3-L9: two thirds of a year of 365 days are 243d 8h; Leo's 1° in 43 years, 232 days, 6 hours and 46 minutes is 82″,5 a year.

notes_left L16, notes_right L11: in «Brahma–sphuṭa-siddhānta» the first dash measures 4.8 pt, a long dash, the second 3.2 pt, a hyphen; the dash of «al–Bīrūnī» measures 4.7 pt, a long dash; the other dashes of the notes measure 3.0 to 4.2 pt and are hyphens.
notes_right L23-L24: note 5 goes on at the foot of p. 219.
